items.text: Ymir - Magmir - Blazing Bifrost Event Pass
It's time to heat things up, literally!
Maneuver elevation changes and pitfalls, all the while avoiding the firebombs created by the furnaces, in this new distinct map Fiery Furnace!
The Blazing Bifrost Event Pass is here!
To mark the start of our new Season, players can progress the Event Pass to unlock some red hot cosmetics and currencies.
Did we mention, as the very first Event Pass, we’ll give players the Premium upgrade for free? All rewards from all tiers are absolutely free to everyone!
Here's a list of highlights that you can unlock! Please note that there are additional XP Boosters, Stars, and Runes to unlock!

notes.title: Instant Unlock: Bifrost Shatter Knockout FX
Instant Unlock: Magmir, Ready for Battle Banner

items.text: You can find an Event Pass FAQ here!

notes.title: We made major adjustments to the progression in DKO

items.text: We adjusted the god pass XP requirements so that players progress faster within the track, unlocking the gameplay progression earlier. We're lowering the total Experience requirements in the God Pass by roughly 30%.
Divine Traits and Greater Blessings have been moved earlier in the god pass progression track
Lesser Blessings have been removed from the game. It will allow us to create more and more interesting traits for characters in the future. More info on that very soon.
We have a full blog post written up that you can find >>here<< with more information on this change!

Every few weeks there will be map rotations on the 3v3, 2v2 & 1v1 Queues. Please find the first map rotations listed below and keep in mind that we will share future map rotations on our social media channels! (Twitter / Instagram / Discord / Facebook)

Amaterasu's Divine Trait Switching Strike was disabled since it was leading to a spike of power and unbalanced situations. We wanted to design a new talent to replace Switching Strike, returning to have 3 selectable Divine Traits on Amaterasu.
Switching Strike has been replaced by a new talent called Blade Edge.
Blade Edge: The attack after Uppercut grants 10% Ultimate Charge if it is an Air Light (2nd hit) or reduces all cooldowns by 2s if it is Air Heavy.

King Arthur receives some love in this patch. We want to make the tracking, warping, and hitboxes of his attacks consistent with other God metrics since they were slightly shorter. In addition, we make the Ability 2 projectile harder to avoid for opponents, since it was easily avoidable compared to other projectiles in the game.
Updated tracking, warping, and hitbox size of all the attacks.
Increased projectile speed of Soaring Edge by 20% to increase skill check.

Loki has seen a great god release but we hear your voices and we want to adjust him in this patch. We want to provide more awareness to opponents about Loki's stealth activation in order to exactly know when he enters in stealth even not looking at him. Next to this addition, we want to balance the cooldown of Acrobatic Vault since it was obtained too fast leading to a lot of aerial combos. Empowered attacks led to power spikes thanks to huge tracking distance and damage, we wanted to balance them to bring those attacks in a more balanced state. Loki's damage potential was very high due to various combos. We nerfed his damage in several parts of his kit, to spread the nerf and keep abilities and talents interesting. This also includes reducing the damage potential and making the ultimate more avoidable for opponents, since it was more punishing than other ultimates.

Integrate a specific SFX of a laugh (or other sound in line with stealth fantasy) that has to be very recognizable and unique. It has to be heard from close to medium/far distance from opponents to be aware of the stealth activation.
Acrobatic Vault: Increased the cooldown from 17s to 20s.
Obscuring Dagger: Reduced damage from 12 to 10.
Explosive Me:
Added 0.1 on the charging phase to force Loki to wait more time before the Ult is fully charged (providing also more time to refire)
Added 0.1 on the prefire of the explosion to give more reaction time to the opponents to dodge/avoid the explosion
Reduced the dmg bracket of the Ultimate from 20-30 to 17-25 to be more in line with other gods' ult damage
Reduced Ultimate Charge rate by 8% (same as Sun Wukong and King Arthur).
Empowered Air Light:
Reduced warping distance from 9m to 8m
Reduced the velocity of the warping to reduce the "snappy" feeling of the attack and provide more time to react for opponents
Reduced damage from 16 to 12
Empowered Air Heavy Attack:
Reduced the velocity of the warping to reduce the "snappy" feeling of the attack and provide more time to react for opponents
Reduced damage from 16 to 14
Talents
Effect Seeker Divine Trait (Attacks against Poisoned and Blinded enemies deal an additional 2 Damage) reduced damage buff provided from 2 to 1.

Sol receives small Quality of Life changes in this patch. We increase the potency of her healing potential and build after the changes applied in the last patch. Also, Disapparate's animation was not perfectly synced with the start of the movement.
Increased the number of pools created by “The Floor is Lava” from 4 to 6.
Reduced the length of the pre-fire animation by 2 frames.

We continue to hear your feedback about Sun Wukong and we want to provide a subtle way to recognize the clone (in combo with what we already did in the last patch: the clone dealing 30% less dmg) to allow high-skill players to recognize it. Next to this, the Precise Momentum blessing was the only blessing without the God name in the title; we wanted to avoid that kind of inconsistency. And lastly, we update the “Monkey See, Monkey Do” talent to reduce its overall power.
Clone plays specific gameplay cues when is hit by the opponent and when he hits the opponent. The gameplay cues are just slightly different, requiring attention to be recognized.
The talent name of “Precise Momentum” has been updated in “Sun Wukong’s Momentum” to avoid naming inconsistency.
The “Monkey See, Monkey Do” talent has been updated in “Monkey See”, and the clone can now use just The Magic Cudgel (Dashing Strikes has been removed from the talent).
Our team has been hard at work designing a new talent to replace the Wind Runner minor trait since it is too strong and leads to unbalanced power spikes in aerial playstyle.
Talents
Wind Runner replaced by a new Talent: Windstorm
Attacks against enemies trapped by Swirling Tempest deal additional 2 damage and 20% knockback (Up to 6 damage per Attack).
Buff Pads have been added to the following maps for Knockout modes:
Spinning Spikes
Sinking Swamp
Rockslide Ridge
Spellbound Study
Spirit Shrine
Merlin statue has less intrusive invisible collision around it.
Big pillars structure now has even more form accurate collision. This should now also allow crater decals to sometimes not be visible.
We also fixed a bunch of bugs again! Here's a list of highlights:
Character Select now by default highlights the favorite God (or last played God if there is no favorite) instead of Amaterasu.
Added a gamepad key binding option for resetting the camera (default is right stick click).
3vAI switched to Knockout instead of Arcade
Fixed where Loki was playing his Enemy Knockout voice lines when an ally is knocked out
Fixed an issue where Amaterasu's uppercut was sometimes putting her to be behind the target
Changed the name of the Arcade custom tab to 3v3 custom
Fixed an issue where players did not receive daily login rewards if they were loaded into the tutorial.
Fixed where AI Thor's Ability 1 wasn’t displaying the warning
Fixed a controller issue where changing god in practice rooms changes god for the AI
Fixed where Bots were unable to navigate onto the central tower when playing oddball on crumbling keep when nobody was holding the crown
Fixed where Oddball cooldown HUD failed to countdown in a custom arcade game
Fixed an issue if Ymir was standing right next to his wall then he could be hit by abilities thrown at the other side of it

Loki is a trickster, his agility and precision in using daggers make him unpredictable and lethal on the battleground. His acrobatic playstyle is even more powerful while in the air, thanks to empowered attacks. He is also a master of illusions and effects, employing invisibility, poison, magical daggers that obscure the vision of his opponents, and the most powerful trick of all, the creation of a clone that explodes at his command.
Acrobatic Vault
Loki leaps into the air with momentum. His next aerial attack is Empowered, dealing more damage and heavy knockback.
Obscuring Dagger
Loki throws a magical spinning dagger forward that dazes enemies and obscures their vision, as well as dealing damage and knockback.
Hidden in Shadows
Loki enters Stealth, becoming invisible for a short time. The first attack out of stealth applies poison to enemies, dealing additional damage over time.
Explosive Me

Loki spawns a clone that explodes after charging up, dealing massive damage and knockback to enemies in the area of the explosion. However, Loki can refire the ability early to trick his opponents at the cost of dealing less damage and knockback.
Loki - Nordic Nomad - Shop

notes.title: BIG WIN: 3v3 Arcade becomes 3v3 with Knockout only

items.text: The main 3v3 Arcade queue will be moved to include only 3v3 Knockout.
We are going to bring back King of the Hill, Oddball, and Coin Blitz as limited-time modes in the future.
Want to flex a bit more on your enemies? Banners are now available!
A new cosmetic that is shown to players after you knock them out, Banners are a great way to add some style to your skills!

notes.title: New Feature: Skin & God Purchasing during character select

items.text: Queue popped before you could pick up that new Amaterasu skin? Missed using a god token on the newly released Loki before jumping into a 2v2? No worries - Skin and God Purchasing is now available in the Character Select!
We’ve given a bit of spice to the Title cosmetic in DKO - and now show it in a bunch of new places
Titles are now displayed in the Lobby, Character Select, In-Game Scoreboard, and End of Match Scoreboard
Players can now see their Damage Done on the Scoreboard
Knockouts and Assists aren’t the only important part of combat in DKO - dishing out damage is vital to success!

notes.title: Moved Loadout during Character Selection to Skin Selection

items.text: We are working on the Character Select phase a bit - we moved the Loadout selection into the phase after selecting the Character into the phase where Skin selection is made

We have found players using the cancellation of ground-targeted movement abilities to refresh and continue attack chains in the air to impressive effect. While we don’t want to remove this tactic from the playbook at this stage, we are increasing the “cost” of this playstyle by setting the movement ability on a full cooldown (rather than the half cooldown it has been).
Canceling ground-targeted movement abilities (e.g., Thor, Susano) now consumes the full cooldown.

We’re looking to address the difficulty in facing off against Amaterasu is her high combo potential that can make an opponent feel quite powerless in some instances. Critically, we’re removing the easy options for her to trigger her Ultimate ability from other attacks, giving an opponent a window for escape and allowing for more counter-play in these situations.
Amaterasu will not be able to use her “Final Light” ability until the animations for her Air Light, Sunseeker Dash, or Sunlit Uppercut are finished.
Removed the ability to jump-cancel Heavenly Strike on the successful first hit.

Arthur’s performance has been steadily improving over recent patches, but we’re making what I hope will be the last set of buffs for a while as he settles into a better competitive spot, focusing on increasing the damage and knockback of some of his abilities.
Increased damage of Albion’s Rally from 5 to 8.
Increased damage of Might of Excalibur from 23 to 26.
Increased Heavy Air Attack damage from 5 to 6.
Talents
Slice Through: Increased additional knockback by Air Heavy Attacks from 15% to 20%.
We’re making a couple of adjustments to reduce the power of Athena’s aerial playstyle to make it more balanced and reduce instances where players can exploit the spear’s placement.
Reduce the lifetime of the spear from Spear Toss from 5s to 4s.
Increased the cooldown of Parry from 13s to 14s.
Talents
Incoming: Reduced the additional knockback from 20% to 15%.
The lovely goddess of death is in a good place, so we’re just making one change to bring her Ambush talent in line with others that also boost the ultimate charge percentage.
Talents
Ambush: Reduced additional ultimate charge rate from 15% to 12%.

Sol has been underperforming across all queues, particularly in Duel and Brawl. Given the value that her ultimate brings to her kit, we’re reducing its prefire slightly to increase the skill check for her opponents to avoid getting hit.
Reduced prefire of Supernova’s fireball by 0.05s.
Sun Wukong has been dominating Duel and Brawl in recent weeks, so we’re reducing the impact of two of his most impactful abilities.
Increased cooldown of The Magic Cudgel from 14s to 16s.
The clone now deals 30% less damage than Sun Wukong.

We’re pleased to see that the changes made to Susano in the last patch have had the intended result to bring him in line with the other gods. He’s still over-performing a little so we’ve got a few more targeted changes to smooth over some undesirable power spikes.
Increased prefire of Air Light from 0.25s to 0.3s.
Reduced the hitbox size of the Light Attack chain by 20%.
Talents
Send Off: Additional damage by Air Heavy attacks reduced from 4 to 3.
In the current meta, Thanatos has had a slightly overstated presence in all queues, so we’re making two small changes to reduce his highest impact points.
The number of healing orbs released by players from Soul Leech has been reduced from 5 to 4.
Talents
Unyielding: The cap per attack has been reduced from 3 to 2.
Thor has been in a healthy competitive place for most skill brackets, so we’re making a few talent tweaks to improve his build diversity.
Talents
Warrior's Madness: Reduced additional damage from 6 to 5.
Face The Hammer: The additional damage of the final hits of Light Attack chains has been reduced from 6 to 5.
Crashing Down: Additional damage by Anvil of Dawn reduced from 10 to 8.

The recent changes to Zeus' ultimate were quite impactful but our attempts to reduce its presence made for an unintended nerf. We’re balancing this out by increasing the usefulness of the initial part of the ability.
Increased the number of bolts thrown at a time for the first part of Heaven’s Rage from 3 to 4.
Sol’s Temper: Reduced additional damage done to the last enemy that knocked you out from 25% to 15% and the additional damage if you haven’t been knocked out from 12.5% to 10%.
Sharpened Sickle: Reduced cap per Attack or Ability from 3 to 2.
Upward Slash: Reduced additional damage done by Air Heavy attacks from 4 to 3.
Air Supremacy: The cap for additional damage per attack has been reduced from 6 to 4.
Moved Spawn Points for Team 1 further away from the Bank on Coin Blitz, so both teams are more at an equal distance away from it.
Improved collision around the edges of the map to allow for more consistent clamber behaviour.
Adjustment to the collision along the corner edges of the platforms no longer causes rare instances of players bouncing inwards towards the platform.
Disabled collision on a platform below the KO floor that you could previously stand on.
Changed the collision along the central ramp to be one single ramp, to allow for more fluid movement.
Made the collision around the giant bookcase more shape-accurate and moved the bookcase back by 1,5 meters.
We also fixed a bunch of bugs (it may or may not be more than 100 this time). We hear your feedback and would like to share more fixes here:
Quests: Fixed progress tracking of Projectile damage & Hold Heavy KOs.
Fixed crash when loading out of the Combat Room in the Practice Map.
Fixed a crash sometimes caused by Izanami’s “Spectral Projection”.
Izanami can jump while aiming “Seeking Sickle”.
Attacking out of tiger form of Sun Wukong’s “72 Transformations” ability will no longer cause the player camera to stutter.
Fixed a bug where Sun Wukong’s staff would be invisible when attacking from off-screen.
Thor’s icons will longer be swapped for “Mjolnir’s Attunement” and “Tectonic Rift”.
Ymir can no longer early jump cancel on Light Attack 2.
Ymir’s turn speed while channeling “Frost Breath” will no longer be reduced at any FPS.
Fixed animation bug where aimed abilities sometimes play a land animation when the ability ends.
Team indicators will now show character locations even when high in the air.
Updated the way craters are displayed.
All characters will now play their intro animations at the same time at the start of the first round of a match.
Fixed issue with player titles appearing in unintended menus.
Titles in character selection will no longer appear as “No Title” if a player has none equipped.
Added Esc menu (Settings & Quit) access to the character selection screen.
In character selection, gods will now play a selection animation when equipping a skin.
Fixed an issue where Settings menu dropdowns would conflict with pop-ups.
The favorite God button hitbox has been adjusted to always be the same size as it looks.
Fixed UI issue in Brawl where the announcements would show the incorrect score.
Fixed audio bug in Brawl where the Announcer would play random announcements over the correct elimination line.
Player HUD no longer disappears in-game after the first round in duel and brawl.
All valid matches now correctly count progress toward achievements and profile stats (KOs, Minutes Played, etc.)
Missing fanfare for some login rewards will no longer be missing.
Added access to the scoreboard at most points in the game.
Banned accounts will now see the appropriate error message.

We want to share some updates and context around balance changes that we will implement as soon as possible. These mainly include changes to Sol and Susano. We’re adjusting Sol’s healing capabilities and Susano will receive a couple of nerfs that will adjust his potency for high-skilled players while still maintaining a high level of fun to play him.
We want to stress that this is one step to improving balance around your feedback and that there is more to come. We will keep monitoring Susano and other gods and goddesses very closely!

In our effort of creating an exciting playstyle for Sol, we went overboard and created a balance problem. We will be adjusting further in the next patch but for now, we’re reverting our change to the “Healing Flame” talent.
Talents
Healing Flame: Reduced healing from 2 to 1 after walking over a fire pool and consuming it.

Susano has balance issues at the highest level of play and game knowledge. These changes are only the first batch. We’re starting to address his ability to deal a high amount of damage and the speed at which he recovers from the different phases of Storm Kata's ability. Additionally, we’re removing his talent allowing him to triple jump. We will re-introduce a 3rd divine trait for Susano in one of the future updates.
Reduced the damage of air light attacks from 2-2-3 to 1-1-2
Storm Kata: Increase postfire time of hits to make them more punishable, still allowing the players to combo with light and heavy out of Storm Kata.
First hit: from 0.59s to 0.73s
Second hit: from 0.2s to 0.4s
Third hit: from 0.64s to 0.8s
Talents
Rising Winds: Reduced the additional Damage to targets in the air from 2 to 1
Wind Runner: Disabled while we’re working on a rework/replacement
Fixed an issue where wrong rewards were highlighted on the daily login reward screen.
Fixed crash occurrences for Izanami's ability “Spectral Projection”. However, we are still trying to polish it further for better performance.
Mechaterasu Amaterasu - Shop
Test your might in a forgotten corner of an arcane archive under the watchful gaze of countless tomes. But watch out for magical bookcases seeking to disrupt your plans for a fair fight!

Sometimes, you just want to keep things nice and straightforward. Sometimes, you want to show other people who the best DKO player is, with nothing else getting in the way. Now, you can do that in our new 1v1 and 2v2 Map, Champion's Circle!
Daily and Weekly Quests have made their way to DKO!
Daily quests reset daily at 12 am UTC, and weekly ones at 10 am UTC on Tuesday
Claim rewards like God Pass XP Boosters and Stars! Complete all Weekly Quests for a Bonus Reward
The Leaderboards for 1v1 Duel and 2v2 Brawl are now displayed in the game!
The conditions of appearing on the leaderboards are unchanged, they’ll still update daily!
Choose what God to show off to your party!
Select a God in the God Collection page, and mark it as a favorite.
Your favorite God and their equipped skin will show in the lobby every time, so flex those Gold skins!
Boosters are now worth 10 minutes instead of a single match
Existing boosters are converted to time worth their quantity
10 Boosters is 100 minutes of Boosted XP time
This will allow you to play any mode, any queue, and get the same value everywhere from your booster!
XP Boosters are now sold in the Star Shop in packs of 10!
If you want to really power up your God Pass XP gains, 500 Stars will net you 10 Boosters, worth 100 minutes of 50% extra XP!
Amaterasu has an inconsistency with her Air Light’s warp range that we want to iron out. We’re also making a few changes to some of her traits to improve build options.
Reduced warp range of Air Light from 8m to 4m.
Talents
Absolutely Dashing: Removed Ultimate Charge on ability usage. Now grants a 7.5% charge on hitting an enemy
Agile Aura: Increased movement speed buff from 12.5% to 15%.
“Agile Aura” is now in Amaterasu’s default set instead of “Absolutely Dashing”
Empowered Aura: Increased the additional knockback from 10% to 15%.
King Arthur has been doing better with the changes in the previous patch, so we’re closer to where we’d like to be, which necessitates only one update this time around.
Blinding Light: Increased damage from 12 to 15.
Sol is getting some talent changes to improve her viability across all queues and add some tougher choices in her build-crafting.
Talents
Blazing Trail: Changed the way cooldown reduction is applied per hit by the ability. The first hit with the ability reduces the cooldown by 4s, and each subsequent hit reduces the cooldown by 2s.
Healing Flame: Increased healing from each Fire Pool from 1 to 2.
Hot Streak: Increased cooldown reduction from 9s to 10s.
Line of Fire: Increased additional knockback caused at close range from 25% to 30%.
Sun Spots: Updated text description to clarify the number of Fire Pools created.
Our resident Ice Giant’s ultimate is a little too effective, so we’re reducing its power ever so slightly.
Reduced knockback of Ymir’s Ult by 10%.

The ruler of Olympus has provided plenty of fresh energy to DKO since he joined the fight but he needs a little tune-up to give everybody a fair chance and improve his chances in 1v1/2v2. His ultimate in particular, while exciting and terrifying at the same time, has a little too much presence when he casts it and we want to make the tactical play around it a little more interesting.
Adjusted motion and warp range of Air Light from 10m to 7.5m.
Bolt of Olympus: Increased projectile speed by 15%.
Heaven’s Rage:
Reduced the number of bolts thrown from 15 to 9, so Zeus will now throw 3 sets before snapping his fingers for a Lightning Strike.
Increased the damage of each bolt from 4 to 6.
Reduced prefire of the final Lightning Strike by 0.05s.
Increased ultimate charge by 6%.
Second buff pad added to the middle of the arena
Buff pad on the boat swapped to a movement buff
Buff pad in the middle of the arena includes the health buff
More than 100 bugs were fixed in that build. Highlighting the ones that have the most consequences on gameplay.
Bolt of Olympus (Zeus ability) charging UI now correctly represents the charged state.
Sharp-eyed (Thor Lesser Blessing) will now work correctly with Zeus' Bolt of Olympus.
Activating Sun Wukong’s “72 Transformations” ability immediately after spawning will no longer prevent the ability from going on cooldown.

The playful trickster of legend uses his staff and speed to take the fight to his enemies and leave them no room to breathe. Capable alone or as part of a team, even more so when his clone is on the field.
72 Transformations

Sun Wukong transforms into an animal and dashes forward. If used on the ground, he becomes a tiger and, from the air, an eagle. Refire the ability to break out of the movement early and attack an opponent in range.
The Magic Cudgel

Sun Wukong extends his staff out to poke in front of him, increasing its size to cover a large distance and wide area. Hitting an enemy with the end of the staff will deal additional damage and knockback.
Dashing Strikes
Becoming a blur of destruction, Sun Wukong performs 3 quick, rolling attacks. The first two attacks hit knock back enemies a short distance, with a final spinning attack that knocks all enemies away.
Monkey Clone

Sun Wukong plucks a few strands of hair and creates a clone of himself that moves to attack the closest enemy, using only basic attacks. The ability can then be refired once to swap positions with the clone.
Cyber Samurai Susano - Shop
First Pri-Mate Sun Wukong - Shop

Duke it out beneath a red sky in this spacious arena, where the key to victory lies in controlling the high ground. Make your opponent's see that there is not enough room to go around for the best fishing spot in the east!
Receive bonus rewards for daily logins, including extra Boosters, Runes and Stars - even a cosmetic!

notes.title: New Feature: Bots in Custom Games

items.text: Players can now add bots to their Custom Games! Add any specific Gods to test your skills against your biggest nemesis on any maps.
Players are now able to change Skins during the character selection screen
Players have a few seconds less to select their God, but more time to choose the right Talent Loadout
Players now don’t see their opponents Gods before everyone is locked in
While invulnerable, players with the oddball will not gain points
While holding the oddball, players can no longer use their movement abilities
Doubled look sensitivity range on controller
Added a button to snap the camera in character's facing direction
We’re reducing the charge rate of Amaterasu’s ultimate to balance out its higher efficiency and combo potential.
Reduced Ultimate charge rate by ~14%.

Arthur’s not faring as well as we’d like in some fights, so we’ve reduced two of his ability cooldowns to bring them closer to the other gods. Additionally, his ultimate charge rate has been increased to give it more chances to make an impact in a round.
Soaring Edge
Reduced cooldown to 16s (from 18)
Blinding Light
Reduced cooldown to 16s (from 18)
Might of Excalibur
Increased Ultimate Charge Rate by 9%
Susano’s Air attacks were too efficient. We reduced his ability to track targets in the air. This will be most noticeable against a player who dodges away from Susano.
Air Light
Vertical targeting range is reduced to 2.5m - 4m (from 3.5m - 5m)
Air Heavy
Reduced Air Heavy warp range to 6m (from 8m)
Thanatos' “Unyielding” talent was overly strong in Duel because it allowed players to maintain the damage buff when targeting and hitting the same target.
Talents
Unyielding’s damage increase is reset if Thanatos hits an enemy with an ability

We found that Thor’s Air Heavy attack did not match the visuals, so we increased the time that the hitbox is present and added horizontal warp that was previously missing. Further to that, we’ve looked at his talents, to make Capacitor’s effect more consistent and have adjusted the starting loadout to improve his viability for players using him for the first time.
Air Heavy
Increased time hitbox is active on Air Heavy by 30%
Added a 4.5m warp distance (from 0 warp distance before)
Talents
Capacitor
Thor now gains 5% ultimate charge for the first player it hits and then 2% per additional enemy hit (changed from 3.5% gained per hit).
Face The Hammer
Swapped with Crashing Down in the default loadout
We've fixed over 100 bugs(!) since last build, here are the highlights:
Fixed a bug that allowed some players to load earlier in a game
Fixing a bug that was causing a bot remaining in-game after a player re-joins
Fixed a bug causing Oddball to not spawn when launching game mode
Fixed a bug that was causing allowing players to be untouchable in Oddball on Crumbling Keep
Fixed a bug allowing players to score points if eliminated under the bank in Coin Blitz
Fixed a bug that was causing Izanami’s ultimate to disappear when hitting Athena’s ultimate
Kata Combo (Susano talent) should now affect cooldown correctly
Icicle Falls (Ymir talent) should now deal damage when Ymir is off of the icicle
Stikes Twice (Thor talent) is now correctly reducing cooldown by 3.5 seconds instead of adding 3.5 seconds
Mjolnir fury (Thor talent) is now correctly activating even if not hitting an enemy
Hey there KO Crew! We've recently released a small patch to address some immediate concerns & issues:
We’ve listened to the feedback and understand that the rate of progression isn’t in line with expectations.
With that in mind, in the short term, we’re increasing the XP gained for all queues.

Furthermore, 1v1 and 2v2 matches were behind in term of progression and will now award an additional 25% compared to the Arcade queue to account for the difference in time to go from one match to the other, as individual matches are rewarding less XP.
In the long term, expect more systems allowing you to gain XP and Boosters. But for the meantime, profit from your free 50 boosters
XP gains increased by 10%
XP gains in 1v1/2v2 are now 25% more compared to 3v3
XP win bonuses for Duel and Brawl set to 1.5x (from 1.25x)
Extended end lag on abilities out of air heavy

Susano has too much presence in fights, and we will address it fully in a later patch. For now, we’re bringing his light attacks in line with the rest of the characters in order to make sure missing light attacks can be punished and that Susano cannot land light attacks in a way that’s abusive.
Reduced attack distance of second light attack by 2m
Reduced attack distance on third light attack by 2m

Thanatos has been underperforming slightly, particularly in 1v1, so we’ve made a few changes to improve his viability in solo fights. Some of his talents have also been returned to increase their usefulness across all queues.
Light Attack
Increased attack distance on first light attack by 2m
Increased attack distance on second light attack by 1m
Increased attack distance on third light attack by 1m
Held Heavy Attack
Increased hit window of Held Heavy Attack
Ability: Soul Leech
Increased healing per orb by 1
Talent: Blood Omen
Increased extra damage from 4 to 6
Talent: Speed Demon
Increased movement speed from 20% to 30%
Increased distance from target from 25m to 35m
Talent: Cursed Scythe
Increased extra On The Hunt damage to 15
Talent: Marked for Death
Increased extra damage to 3
Blessing: Weakness in Numbers
Increased outnumbered distance from 8m to 10m
New shiny icon for PlayStation app
Better messaging for players who don’t have up-to-date NVIDIA drivers
Fixed causes for multiple crashes
Fixed an issue where players could start casting and cancel an Aerial ability after an Air Light to break out of end lag early and drop to the ground.
Come Back talent should now be properly reducing movement ability cooldown
